target.scope: one exact offer per fixture; no qualification, handicap or extra time

hypothesis: A confirmed official starting-lineup change relative to a separately received prior official confirmed lineup improves out-of-sample multiclass log loss beyond the identical-time market and no-fact baseline.
eligibility: Actual bytes and actual receipt timestamps for both versions, fixture, player and team identity; decision and full quote received by T-30; documented 90-minute settlement and result available after event; changes to probable or predicted lineups excluded. Missing earlier confirmed version is unknown, not zero.
context: Record venue neutrality, stage, leg, aggregate score and competition calendar as contemporaneously evidenced fields; missing context excludes the fact model. No invented rotation, effect, coefficients or earlier prices. First leg aggregate is explicitly not applicable.
design: One candidate: multiclass market-offset regularized logistic model with one pre-specified binary lineup-change indicator and class interactions; market baseline is normalized same-offer inverse odds, no-fact baseline is identical model with indicator fixed zero. Fit only on earlier received results. All coefficients learned solely in training, no manual bonuses.
time_split: After prospective enrollment, assign chronological nonoverlapping training, validation and untouched test blocks (60/20/20 by event date) before opening labels; keep matchdays together, require result receipt before fitting and 7-day embargo. Freeze model and code after validation; evaluate test once. No sequential test-driven tuning.
selection_stop: Before training require at least 300 training, 100 validation and 200 test eligible unique fixtures, at least 30 change-positive fixtures in each block, all three outcomes in each block and coverage at least 80 percent of all eligible target opportunities. Otherwise blocked_data. Candidate proceeds only if validation log loss is lower than no-fact baseline; otherwise stop. Test improvement requires paired four-week block bootstrap 95% CI of log-loss gain entirely above zero, Brier no worse, and explicit independent review; ROI is descriptive and cannot trigger adoption.
comparison: On identical games and complete quotes compare market, frozen operating selection if actually preserved and identifiable, no-fact model and candidate; report any different coverage separately. One unit per selected 90-minute outcome; report n, coverage, accuracy, ROI, multiclass log loss, multiclass Brier, daily settled maximum drawdown and exclusions, without claiming executable price or changing wallet limits.
checks: Reject source receipt after decision/T-30, mismatched fixture/player/offer, duplicate documents by actual byte hash with conflicts excluded, result-before-start, incomplete quote and future-label poisoning; verify documented chronology and byte provenance separately from digest integrity. Do not train or calculate metrics without new eligible evidence.
